title: Task params for oedis.handler.file.delete
description: Configuration for deleting files or directories inside the task inbox using the file handler.

requests.description: List of delete instructions. Each item describes which inbox files or directories to match and remove.

src_dir.description: Source directory to read from. If omitted, files are read from ctx.inbox. Relative paths are resolved from ctx.inbox and must stay inside it.

include.description: File or directory match pattern or list of patterns to include. Matching is always against the candidate path relative to src_dir. It does not do separate basename matching.

exclude.description: File or directory match pattern or list of patterns to exclude after include matching. Matching is always against the candidate path relative to src_dir.

recursive.description: When true, walk subdirectories under src_dir. When false, only files and directories directly under src_dir are considered.
